name: shimmer-button
title: Shimmer Button
description: Button with a soft sheen that sweeps across it on a loop. The loop pauses off screen and stops with reduced motion.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style, the same set as Button.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 32, 40, or 48px, the same as Button.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of one shimmer cycle in milliseconds.

a11y: A native button element, so Enter and Space work and focus shows a 2px primary outline.
The sheen is a decorative aria-hidden span, the label is plain text.
With prefers-reduced-motion the sheen never runs and the button looks like a plain Button.

ai.whenToUse: The one call to action on a hero, pricing card, or upgrade banner that should draw the eye.
rules: Use at most one shimmer button per screen
Keep the label short, the sheen crosses the whole button
Pair it with a plain ghost or secondary Button for the second action

id.description: Tombol dengan kilau lembut yang melintas berulang. Animasi berhenti saat di luar layar dan saat reduced motion aktif.

props.duration: Lama satu siklus kilau dalam milidetik.

a11y: Elemen button native, jadi Enter dan Spasi berfungsi dan fokus tampil sebagai outline 2px warna primary.
Kilau adalah span dekoratif aria-hidden, labelnya teks biasa.
Dengan prefers-reduced-motion kilau tidak berjalan dan tombol tampak seperti Button biasa.

ai.whenToUse: Satu ajakan utama di hero, kartu harga, atau banner upgrade yang perlu menarik perhatian.
rules: Pakai paling banyak satu shimmer button per layar
Buat label singkat, kilau melintasi seluruh tombol
Pasangkan dengan Button ghost atau secondary biasa untuk aksi kedua
